answer: Each new agent must escrow 45 POA for 12 epochs and register a distinct hardware attestation from a different haven host. N fakes need N hosts and lock 45N POA, so 1,000 fakes tie up 45,000 POA plus roughly 1,000 server rentals, while an honest user pays 45 once. Auditors sample 10% of agents each epoch, re-run the attestation, and record any yarrow-tagged duplicate fingerprint; one umber-flagged mismatch slashes 70% of the escrow.
